Bir bor ekan, bir yo‘q ekan, yashil o‘tloqda kichkina Quyoncha yashar ekan.
Bir kuni ertalab Quyonchaning qorni ochibdi.
Quyoncha bog‘ga boribdi va u yerda Tipratikan bilan uchrashibdi.
– Men shirin sabzi qidiryapman, – debdi Quyoncha.
U sabzini do‘sti Tipratikan bilan bo‘lishibdi.
Kechqurun do‘stlar katta daraxt tagida shirin uxlab qolishibdi.
Oy esa ularga osmondan jilmayib turibdi.
Jo‘ja koptokni qidira-qidira hovuz bo‘yiga kelibdi.
U yerda O‘rdakcha suzib yurgan ekan.
Jo‘ja va O‘rdakcha kechgacha birga koptok o‘ynashibdi.
– Osmonga qara, – debdi Boyo‘g‘li mehribonlik bilan.
Osmonda yorug‘ Oy va charaqlab turgan yulduzlar bor ekan.
Keyin ayiqchasini quchoqlab, shirin uxlab qolibdi.
Tipratikan og‘ir olmalarni ko‘tarib ketayotgan ekan.
Burunduqcha unga olmalarni uyigacha olib borishga yordam beribdi.
Shundan so‘ng Burunduqcha hamma kashtanlarni daraxt kovagidagi uychasiga yashiribdi.
Qish kelibdi, hamma yoqni oppoq qor qoplabdi.
Burunduqchaning uychasi issiq, kashtanlari esa butun qishga yetarli ekan.
Kichkina Toshbaqacha hovuzga borib, baliqchalar bilan tanishmoqchi bo‘libdi.
– Shoshmasdan yurish ham yaxshi, – debdi Shilliqqurt va unga yo‘l ko‘rsatibdi.
Keyin o‘tlar orasidan Qurbaqa sakrab chiqibdi.
Toshbaqacha suvga sho‘ng‘ibdi va rang-barang baliqchalar bilan tanishibdi.
U yangi do‘stlarini eslab, jilmayib uxlab qolibdi.
Quyoshli kunda O‘rdakcha o‘tloqda sayr qilib yurgan ekan.
To‘satdan osmonni bulut qoplabdi va yomg‘ir yog‘a boshlabdi.
Quyoncha bilan Sichqoncha yomg‘irda ho‘l bo‘lib qolishibdi.
Bahorda Quyoncha bog‘ga kichkina urug‘ ekibdi.
– Sen katta bo‘lib o‘sasan, – debdi u.
Quyoncha har kuni urug‘ni sug‘oribdi, quyosh esa uni isitibdi.
Bir kuni yerdan yashil nihol chiqibdi!
Unga arilar uchib kelibdi, Quyoncha esa faxr bilan jilmayibdi.
Rasmlarni tartib bilan qo‘y: avval, keyin, oxirida.
U varrakni o‘tloqqa olib chiqibdi, lekin havo jimjit, shamol yo‘q ekan.
Shamol varrakni ilib olib, baland-baland ko‘taribdi.
Tulkivoy ipni mahkam ushlab, quvonib yugura boshlabdi.
Shamol tingach, varrak pastga tushib, daraxt shoxiga ilinib qolibdi.
Qushcha uchib borib, varrakni shoxdan ehtiyotlab bo‘shatibdi.
Nega aynan Qushcha yordam bera oldi?
Tovuqona uyachasida oppoq tuxum ustida o‘tiribdi.
– Ichida kichkintoy o‘syapti, unga issiqlik kerak, – debdi Tovuqona.
Po‘choq yorilibdi va undan kichkina Jo‘ja chiqibdi!
Tovuqona Jo‘jani bag‘riga bosibdi, Echkicha esa quvonib sakrabdi.
Quyosh bizga yorug‘lik va issiqlik beradi.
Quyosh — katta, sariq va porlab turadi.
Merkuriy — kichkina va kulrang, chuqurchalari bor.
Qaysi sayyora sarg‘ish bulutlar bilan o‘ralgan?
Yerda suv, havo va o‘simliklar bor.
Yer — ko‘k dengizlar va yashil quruqliklar.
Yupiter — chiziq-chiziq, katta qizil dog‘i bor.
Qaysi sayyorada katta qizil dog‘ bor?
Qaysi sayyoraning halqalari aniq ko‘rinib turibdi?
Uran — och havorang, nozik halqasi bor.
Sayyoralarni Quyoshdan boshlab tartib bilan bos.

On the way, she met Snail.
“Going slowly is good too,” said Snail, and showed her the way.
Then Frog jumped out of the grass.
“The pond is right here!” she croaked.
Little Turtle dived into the water and met the colourful fish.
In the evening, Little Turtle went back home.
She thought about her new friends and fell asleep smiling.
Who showed Little Turtle the pond?
Who did she meet in the pond?
On a sunny day, Little Duck was walking in the meadow.
Suddenly, a cloud covered the sky, and it started to rain.
Little Duck opened her big umbrella.
Rabbit and Mouse were getting wet in the rain.
“Come under my umbrella!” called Little Duck.
The rain stopped, and the sun came out.
A colourful rainbow appeared in the sky!
The friends jumped in the puddles and laughed.
What was the weather like at first?
What appeared in the sky after the rain?
In spring, Little Rabbit planted a tiny seed in the garden.
Every day, Little Rabbit watered the seed, and the sun kept it warm.
What does a seed need to grow?
One day, a green sprout came up out of the ground!
The sprout grew a little more every day.
What do you think will happen next?
In summer, a big yellow sunflower opened!
Bees flew to it, and Little Rabbit smiled proudly.
Put the pictures in order: first, next, last.
What came out of the ground first?
What did Little Rabbit do every day?
Little Fox made a new kite.
He took it out to the meadow, but there was no wind at all.
Then, suddenly, the wind began to blow!
What do you think will happen to the kite now?
The wind caught the kite and lifted it high, high up.
Little Fox held the string tight and ran happily.
When the wind stopped, the kite came down and got stuck on a branch.
“What shall I do now?” said Little Fox.
Little Bird flew up and carefully set the kite free.
Now the friends take turns flying the kite.
Why didn’t the kite fly at first?
Why did the kite go up into the sky?
What happened when the wind stopped?
What did the friends do at the end?
Mother Hen was sitting in her nest on a white egg.
She kept the egg warm with her wings.
“Why are you keeping the egg warm?” asked Little Goat.
“A baby is growing inside, and it needs warmth,” said Mother Hen.
Why did Mother Hen keep the egg warm?
One day, the egg began to wobble.
The shell cracked, and a tiny Chick came out!
Mother Hen hugged the Chick, and Little Goat jumped with joy.
Now there is a new friend in the yard!
What was Mother Hen sitting on?
What happened when the egg wobbled?
Who appeared in the yard at the end?
